desc:
Welcome to Would You Rather: Winter Contest Tower ❄️✨

Choose a door and build your perfect winter outfit one step at a time! 💙
Will you go Winter ❄️, Christmas 🎄, Ice Princess 👑, Cozy Winter ☕... or discover a completely different style? 👀
Reach the top, enter the Outfit Contest, and show everyone your final look! 👑
Build a look so good it can take 1st place and win again! 🏆✨

Every choice gives you something new:
🧥 fluffy coats, sweaters & snow boots
🎀 hair, earmuffs & cozy accessories
✨ sparkly icy details to complete your look
💀 or something that can totally ruin your outfit

Which winter style will you choose? 👀
Can you become the best-dressed player in the tower? ⛄✨

❤️ Like the game + join the group for extra perks
